$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: Domain History Lookup - WHOIS History + Past Owner Contacts
seoDescription: Domain history lookup API. Find who owned a domain in the past: WHOIS history, Wayback pages, and the owner's emails, phones and names, each with a source URL and date.
isPublic$comment: Publication is declared here so GitHub governs it like every other listing field. Published 2026-09-11 (v1.0). To unpublish, set false and push.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 2 GB is efficient since the ONNX thread cap (Standard scan 351s, 0.195 CU). Memory x timeout is the compute ceiling the start fee must cover: 2 GB x 1800 s = 1 CU = $0.20 at the developer rate. A user who raises memory pays the start fee per GB, which scales with the higher ceiling. Apify rejects unknown keys inside this object, so the comment lives here.

pricing.$comment: First-time set, applied by CI when the platform has no pricing yet; afterwards Apify allows one change per 30 days, so later changes go through Console. Sizing: developer cost is $0.20 per CU (measured $0.205 on five runs); Quick scan $0.02, Standard $0.04, ceiling at the 2 GB / 1800 s defaults $0.20. The start event bills once per GB: 2 x $0.125 = $0.25 per run at defaults, of which the developer keeps 80% = $0.20, so a run that hits the full ceiling with nothing found still breaks even (the nmap lesson). Contacts and mentions are priced apart so a big corporate archive with 140 named universities does not cost the user $4 in mention rows. Do not add apify-default-dataset-item: rows are charged by the contact and mention events from code, and the summary row is free. Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

contact.eventDescription: One row per contact per source: an email, a phone number, a person or organisation that is part of the site, or a registrant detail from WHOIS history, certificates or public code. Each row carries the URL and capture date it came from.

mention.eventDescription: A person or organisation named in the site's content rather than part of the site, such as a company in a biography or a university in an article. Kept for context, priced at a tenth of a contact.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
